changes.title: Automation editor: add a step between any two, and keys T, C and A
changes.detail:
Batch 54, the rest of the design board "Adding a trigger, condition or action". Unit tested; not seen in a browser.

- A slim "Add a step here" control between any two steps, in root and nested lists, for automations and scripts. The new step lands at that position, not at the end. Placed between two triggers of a group, it joins the group. No control is drawn inside a folded group, between rows fast mode has not drawn, or while the list is read-only. - T adds a trigger, C a condition, A an action, in the visual editor. Never while typing in a field, inside a dialog, with a modifier held, or with keyboard shortcuts switched off. The three keys are listed in the shortcuts dialog. - Not done on purpose: the board says Ctrl Shift F adds anything by name. That shortcut opens the command palette, which does not add steps, so the hint would be untrue. The add dialog's own search does that job.

Checks: full suite 7,629 passed with the 3 known build-script failures; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors.
changes.detail_yue: 第 54 批。自動化編輯器兩個步驟之間多咗粒「喺度加一步」，加嘅嘢會落喺 嗰個位，唔使加完再拖上去。鍵盤撳 T、C、A 就分別加觸發、條件、動作； 打緊字或者開住對話框嗰陣唔會亂彈。設計圖話 Ctrl Shift F 可以「乜都加」， 但嗰個掣其實係開指令面板，寫落去就係講大話，所以冇跟。

changes.title: String builder for text fields that accept a template
changes.detail:
Batch 53. The owner, adding a to-do item from an automation on a phone: "add string builder, like when the user wants to add an entity state, date time comparisons and stuff."

- A "Build text" button beside text fields in automation and script actions and on the template editor. It opens a dialog, a bottom sheet on a phone. - Pieces instead of template code: plain text, an entity's state or attribute, its name or area, date and time (24-hour by default), time since or until, numbers with rounding and arithmetic, "if this then that" comparisons one level deep, counts, and a raw template piece for anything else. - Plain text is escaped so it stays plain text. Only reading functions that exist in this server's template helpers are written. - A live preview comes from the server's own template rendering, with its error text shown as it is and a note when a value only exists while the automation runs. - Text the builder wrote opens as pieces again. - Not offered where a value is sent as typed and never rendered: the developer tools action page and the dashboard action editors. - After merging the design lane's "Add trigger, condition and action at the top": its new Cantonese string is
changes.detail_yue: 第 53 批。屋主喺手機加待辦事項嗰陣話：要個「字串建構器」。而家文字欄 隔籬多咗粒「砌文字」掣：唔使識模板語法，揀「實體狀態」「日期時間」 「如果…就…否則…」呢啲件頭砌出嚟，下面即時睇到伺服器計出嚟嘅結果。 純文字會自動跳脫，唔會無端端變咗模板。砌過嘅文字再開返會還原做件頭。 未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Second half of canvas 31; two keys and a slider everywhere; records
changes.detail:
Batch 52. Build 401 was viewed and is live. Unit tested; server parts run for real; the interface in this batch has not been seen in a browser.

- The two-key confirmation is the two keys and the slider on every device. The typed-word form built from a design board is out of use: the owner does not want anything typed. Confirmation titles wrap. - Release notes carry the time of the update; the session clock and the build stamps use the 24-hour clock. - Automation editor: fast mode for very large automations, trigger groups, a Relationships tool, Simple and Advanced levels. - Performance diagnostics from real timings and an offline cache page. - Dashboard editing: multi-select, a clipboard shared between tabs, duplicate, a Dashboards card, swiping between dashboards on a phone. - Light card sliders, energy colours, the rainbow colour picker. - Wall tablet mode and a small `wall_tablet` server integration. - Two-column setup forms, an accessible entity picker, notes on devices and entities, an editor's own shortcut list. - Sidebar names and default pages, outside link choice, a quick bar that remembers, a dark mode readability check. - Records: feature status, roadmap, 17 articles an
changes.detail_yue: 第 52 批。兩把鎖匙加條滑桿，邊部機都係咁，唔使再打字（之前跟設計圖整咗 個「打字再撳住」版本，屋主話唔要，收返）。畫布 31 下半場齊晒：大型自動化 快速模式、觸發條件分組、效能診斷、多選卡片、跨分頁剪貼簿、掛牆平板模式、 裝置備註、深色模式可讀性檢查。掛牆平板個伺服器部分編譯過關，但真係跑 先發現有個服務少咗個參數，成個整合起唔到身；執咗再跑，得咗。發佈說明 而家會寫埋更新時間。

changes.title: Automation editor: Add trigger, condition and action at the top
changes.detail:
On a new automation the three Add buttons sat below six large starting point cards, so on a phone they were more than a screen down and the floating save bar covered the last one. Now:

- the three Add buttons are always at the top of the editor; - on a narrow screen the starting points are one swipeable row; - the editor leaves room at the end so the save bar never covers the last Add button.

Each section gained openAddDialog(), the same dialog its own Add button opens. Seen in a running build at 1440 and 390 pixels: the buttons are at the top and Add action opens its dialog.

changes.title: Marketplace: add from a ZIP file, found without a history folder
changes.detail:
Batch 51. The owner asked for a second way into "Add from a GitHub link": upload a ZIP of a repository folder, let the product dig for what is in it, and say what it found, even when the archive has no .git folder.

- Detection reads marker files, not history: an integration manifest, a dashboard card script, theme files, templates, blueprints, an app repository or an app, through wrapper folders up to three deep, the shallowest match first. A .git folder, when present, only adds the origin and branch as information. - The browser reads the archive's directory and unpacks only the small marker files; nothing is sent until Add. The server checks everything again: size, entry count, unpacked size, ratio, no "..", absolute paths, drive letters, symlinks, encryption or ZIP64. - One administrator-only endpoint places the chosen item, never overwrites anything it did not create, refuses built-in integration domains, and runs the same follow-up steps as an install. - A "Repository found" or "App found" dialog lists each item, how it was recognised and what Add will do. Items that run code need the two-step confirmation. Apps are recognised but not added from a file. - Run for real on a th
changes.detail_yue: 第 51 批。Marketplace 而家可以掟個 ZIP 入嚟，唔使有 .git：佢睇標記檔案 （整合個 manifest、卡片個 script、主題檔）就認得係乜，再彈個「搵到儲存庫」 或者「搵到應用程式」畀你睇清楚先加。安全係重點：瀏覽器同伺服器各自 檢查一次，「../」呢類路徑、捷徑檔、加密檔一律拒收，內置整合唔畀冚。 伺服器端點喺一次性實例度真係試過：正常嘅入到，有古怪嘅全部彈返轉頭。

changes.title: Select rows by rule; storage page reads its numbers; fresh README pictures
changes.detail:
Batch 50. Builds 368 and 371 were viewed in a browser and each went live after its pass; this carries what the 371 pass found, plus one feature.

- Select by rule, in every settings list: text contains, does not contain, starts with, ends with or matches a pattern; has or does not have a label; area, integration, domain and state; combined with all, any and not; applied as replace, add, remove or keep only, with a live count first. Unit tested, not seen in a browser. - Storage page: build 371 said "could not be read" although the server call works. The overview element is loaded after the page first draws it, so it connected before its properties arrived and asked with no connection. It now loads on its first update. - The build stamp in the footer, the sidebar and the About page uses the 24-hour clock. - README: five pictures from published build 371 (home with the navigation pane, settings, system, the motion editor, home on a phone), each inspected; no dim sum picture in any of them. - Records: live instance on 368 at 00:27 and on 371 at 01:02 Toronto time, 13 November; the container image publishes about 25 minutes into a release run, long before the operating system images.

C
changes.detail_yue: 第 50 批。清單可以「按規則揀」：有冇某段字、有冇某個標籤、邊個區域、 咩狀態，仲可以「全部符合／任何一個／唔係」咁砌，揀之前睇到中幾多行。 儲存空間頁之前話「讀唔到」，其實伺服器冇事，係個元件未攞到連線就急住 問；而家等第一次更新先問。頁尾個版本時間終於跟 24 小時制。README 換咗 五張由 371 版影返嚟嘅圖，逐張睇過，冇點心相。

changes.title: Recording settings per entity; page tools fold into More on a phone
changes.detail:
Batch 49, the last two pieces of "build all".

- Recorder: a per-entity "keep history" switch and a minimum interval between recorded states, set over a new administrator-only command, stored and applied at once. The check per state change is a dictionary lookup. A change to a different value is always recorded: a door that opens is never thinned out, only repeats are. The YAML filter still wins. - Run for real on a throwaway instance: switched off, a test sensor stopped gaining rows while another kept gaining; with a 60 second interval two repeats added nothing and a new value added one row. - Storage entity view: the two controls, with the estimated saving first. - Phone: page tools fold into one More sheet, the selection bar is a sheet above the phone bar, the discovery browsers share one tab strip.

Checks: full suite 7,372 passed with the 3 known build-script failures; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors. The interface part has not been seen in a browser.
changes.detail_yue: 第 49 批，「全部起晒」最後兩件。每個實體可以自己揀錄唔錄歷史，同埋最 密幾耐錄一次；重點係真係變咗值就一定即刻錄，道門一開唔會畀人慳咗， 淨係慳重複嗰啲。伺服器部分喺一次性實例度真係試過：熄咗嗰粒感應器即刻 唔再加行，另一粒照加；設 60 秒之後重複兩次冇加，換新值加一行。手機 方面，頁面工具收埋入一個「更多」，選取列變咗喺底列上面嘅面板。介面 部分仲未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Build all: the boards that were left unbuilt, with server calls where needed
changes.detail:
Batch 48. The owner said to build everything earlier batches had skipped for lack of data or a page. Unit tested; not seen in a browser, except the server calls, which were run for real on a throwaway instance.

- Server: two recorder storage commands (database size, growth, biggest entities, one entity's rows per day), administrators only, bounded and off the event loop; automation steps may carry an editor lock. - Storage breakdown and a per-entity view with the saving shown before a purge. - Automation: live breakpoints through the trace debugging commands that were there all along, saved test cases with a coverage map, replay of a recorded day, locks on steps. - Motion editor, offline Help page, guidance notes in setup dialogs, progress with recovery, an Extensions page with recorded consent. - Dashboards: drag to resize, a view-only role level, history compare, tap feedback, padding and shadow, card files, cameras, energy cost. - Phone reach, a lock on one value, four pattern workbench gaps closed. - Entity dialogs show the state once; protocol pages get number tiles from real data; pane, select, segmented control and summary lines. - Still not built, with the outside reason i
changes.detail_yue: 第 48 批。屋主一句「全部起晒」，之前話「冇數據所以唔起」嗰堆，今次連 伺服器指令一齊起埋：儲存空間有真數字（資料庫幾大、邊個實體食位最多）、 自動化有真斷點（原來伺服器一早有除錯指令，上一手睇漏咗）、測試案例同 覆蓋圖、重播成日歷史、動畫編輯器、離線說明頁、擴充功能頁、拖拉改卡片 大細、「淨係睇得」角色、歷史圖比較上一期。伺服器嗰幾個指令喺一次性 實例度真係叫過，有數出。剩低幾樣係外面限制，寫明晒原因。其餘只係單元 測試過，未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Community requests from canvas 31, and fixes for what build 348 showed
changes.detail:
Batch 47. Unit tested only; nothing here has been seen in a browser.

- Build 348 fixes: the home greeting is no longer covered by the welcome banner on wide windows; the page menu comes last in the tool pill; list pages have one title block, not two; the avatar is readable in the dark theme. - Scenes: editing no longer drives the room. Preview asks first, applies for 30 seconds and puts things back from a snapshot. - Raw editor: Go to line, a status bar, and Replace entity with a preview. - Automation rows show their entity's state and whether a condition passes right now. - Card styling in the visual editor, validated and applied as custom properties; "Open a pop-up" as a card action. - Default dashboards per kind of device; presentation roles with a Roles page and "Who can see this". Roles hide things; they are not access control, and the interface says so. - Not built, for lack of real data: database size and per-entity storage, an earlier period on history graphs, a view-only role level.

Checks: full suite 7,208 passed with the 3 known build-script failures; type check clean apart from the two known gallery errors.
changes.detail_yue: 第 47 批。畫布 31 嗰批社群許願落地：改場景唔會再即刻郁到間房啲燈，預覽 會問咗先、試 30 秒、之後自動還原；原始編輯器有得跳行同安全換實體； 自動化每一行即時睇到實體狀態同條件過唔過；卡片樣式唔使再裝外掛；撳一下 彈出視窗；按裝置種類揀預設儀表板；仲有「展示角色」（講明只係收埋， 唔係權限）。348 版睇到嘅問題亦執咗：問候語唔再畀橫額遮住、工具藥丸個 選單排返最尾、清單頁唔再有兩個標題。冇真數據嘅嘢照舊唔起。全部只係 單元測試過，未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Side pane for everyone, visibility by state, tag scan, pages to the boards
changes.detail:
Batch 46. Unit tested only; nothing here has been seen in a browser. Build 348 was: the tool pill, the single automation bar and the floating phone bar work, but the pane stayed at the top and the home greeting is cut off, so the live instance stays on 347.

- Navigation pane: the edge moves to a new storage key and nothing writes "top" by itself any more. The one-time reset of batch 45 lost to the settings sync, which brought the old value straight back. - Visibility by entity state for views and for whole dashboards, with And, Or and Not groups. It tidies navigation; it is not access control. - New tag dialog: Scan a tag, with an honest note where the browser has no reader (every browser on an iPhone). - 24-hour time by default. - Dashboard top (breadcrumb, large title, segmented views), entity dialog top, home "Needs you" card, lights, security, energy and climate headers, floating bulk bar, tags as cards, integrations hero, accessibility tools as tiles, three-column pattern workbench, New tab filter chips, a touch form of the two-key confirmation. - Fixes for two test failures batch 44 shipped: malformed example strings and plain browser inputs in four files.

Checks: full suit
changes.detail_yue: 第 46 批。348 版睇過：工具藥丸、自動化單一操作列、手機浮動底列都得，但 側邊窗格仲係黐住頂部（上次嗰個一次性重設打唔贏同步，舊值即刻彈返嚟）， 主頁句問候語仲畀橫額切咗頭，所以正式機暫時留喺 347。今次直接換條新 儲存鍵，冇人再會自動寫「頂部」。另外加咗：檢視同儀表板可以跟實體狀態 顯示或者收埋（有「而且／或者／唔係」群組）、新增標籤可以掃描（iPhone 瀏覽器冇讀卡器，老實寫明）、預設 24 小時制，仲有一大批頁面跟返設計圖。 順手執返第 44 批漏咗嘅兩個測試。全部只係單元測試過，未喺瀏覽器睇過。
